title: The Great War in Egypt
summary: CFAH AP-20: the Great War in Egypt began 1825 BC (363 years after Menes) and, per CFAH-6, lasted 56 years (1825–1769 BC).
description: CFAH AP-20: the Great War in Egypt began 1825 BC (363 years after Menes) and, per CFAH-6, lasted 56 years (1825–1769 BC).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-20: Great War in Egypt: 1825 B.C."; CFAH-6 Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #20 (1825–1769, "Great War lasted 56 years."); CFAH-6 Argument 2 §B
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "Great War lasted 56 years." CFAH-3 gave the start (1825 BC); CFAH-6 adds the 56-year duration ending 1769 BC.
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 9 "Early Egypt and the Exodus of God's People", PDF p. 184 (printed p. 170)
